Looking for a healthier alternative to Carnation Instant Breakfast
Hi /r/nutrition!

My daughter loves drinking these https://www.carnationbreakfastessentials.com/Products/Powder/Classic-French-Vanilla/Description.aspx.  I like the fact that they have vitamins and iron and whatnot added to them, especially since she is so picky about food, but I'm not happy about the amount of sugar in them.  The no sugar added version has artificial sweeteners which is obviously not an option.  

Does anyone know of an alternate product I can try?
